title: Data management
description: Import employees and master data, download templates and export data.

importEmployees.title: Import employees
importEmployees.description: Upload the employee workbook (XLSX or CSV) with Iqama, passport and leave data.

importMasterData.title: Import master data
importMasterData.description: Departments, job titles, locations, cost centers, holidays and employee records.

exportData.title: Export data
exportData.description: Download any dataset you can access as Excel, CSV or PDF.

downloadTemplates.title: Download templates
downloadTemplates.description: Ready-made XLSX templates with instructions and drop-down lists.

importHistory.title: Import history
importHistory.description: Every import with its totals, status and row-level results.

errorReports.title: Error reports
errorReports.description: Imports with rejected rows — download the rows and fix them.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Employee profiles: identity, Iqama, passport, employment and leave balance.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Department codes and names, parent department and head.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Work locations with city and country.

leave_balances.title: Leave balances
leave_balances.description: Opening balance and entitlement per employee, leave type and year.

dependents.title: Dependents
dependents.description: Family members of employees with Iqama and insurance details.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.description: Medical insurance policies of employees and dependents.

documents.title: Documents metadata
documents.description: Document records (type, number, dates) without files.

public_holidays.title: Public holidays
public_holidays.description: Official holidays excluded from leave and SLA working days.

issues.nameRequired: Name is missing — enter the Arabic or English name.
issues.employeeRefRequired: Enter the employee number or the Iqama / ID number.
issues.scientificNotation: {field} “{value}” was shortened by Excel (scientific notation). Format the column as text and re-enter it.
issues.invalidDate: {field}: “{value}” is not a valid date — left empty.
issues.hijriOutOfRange: {field}: the Hijri date “{value}” is outside the supported range (1343–1500 AH).
issues.futureDate: {field}: “{value}” is in the future — left empty.
issues.implausibleDate: {field}: “{value}” is not a plausible date — left empty.
issues.hijriConverted: {field}: converted from the Hijri date “{value}” to {date}.
issues.invalidBoolean: {field}: “{value}” is not Yes or No — left empty.
issues.invalidEmail: {field}: “{value}” is not a valid email — left empty.
issues.invalidPhone: {field}: “{value}” is not a valid phone number — left empty.
issues.invalidOption: {field}: “{value}” is not an accepted value — left empty.
issues.invalidGender: Gender “{value}” is not recognized — left empty.
issues.willCreate: {field} “{value}” does not exist yet and will be created.
issues.duplicateInFile: Duplicate {field} “{value}” — it is already on row {row}.
issues.selfReference: {field} “{value}” points to the same record — ignored.
issues.referenceInFile: {field} “{value}” is on row {row} of this file and will be linked after the import.
issues.matchConflict: Employee number {number} and ID {nationalId} belong to two different employees.
issues.unusualNationalId: Iqama / ID number “{value}” is not 10 digits — please check it.
issues.implausibleAge: Date of birth {value} means an age under 14 — please check it.
issues.endBeforeStart: {field} “{value}” is earlier than the start date.
issues.invalidHijri: “{value}” is not a valid Hijri date.
issues.notHijri: “{value}” looks like a Gregorian date, not Hijri — kept as written.
issues.hijriMismatch: The Hijri expiry “{value}” ({converted}) does not match the Gregorian expiry {date}.
issues.invalidOutsideKingdom: Outside the Kingdom value “{value}” is not recognized — left empty and kept in additional data.
issues.leaveBalanceNoPermission: You can't set leave balances — the leave balance is not imported.
issues.annualLeaveTypeMissing: The annual leave type does not exist — the leave balance is not imported.
issues.personalDataNotUpdated: You can't change identity data, so identity fields of this employee may not be updated.
issues.unknownDependent: Dependent “{value}” was not found for this employee — the policy is saved for the employee.
issues.leaveBalanceFailed: The employee was saved, but the leave balance could not be set: {reason}

wizard.title: Import data
wizard.description: Upload a spreadsheet, map its columns, review every row and import.
wizard.cancelConfirmDescription: The uploaded file and the validation results are discarded. Nothing has been imported yet.

type.title: What are you importing?
type.description: Choose the kind of data in your file. Each type has its own template and checks.
type.noPermission: You don't have permission to import this data.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.description: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 10 MB and 20,000 rows. Arabic or English headers, in any order.
upload.hint: Tip: start from the template — its columns are recognized automatically.
upload.failed: The file could not be read.

sheet.title: Sheet and header row
sheet.description: We picked the sheet and the header row that look like {type} data. Change them if needed.
sheet.previewHint: The highlighted row is used as column headers; rows above it are ignored.
sheet.twoRowHeader: Two-row header detected — group and sub-headers are combined.
sheet.skipped: {blank} blank and {repeated} repeated header rows skipped

mapping.title: Map the columns
mapping.description: Each column in your file is matched to a field. Check the suggestions and change any that are wrong.
mapping.extraHint: Unmapped columns are kept unchanged in the employee's additional data.
mapping.requiredMissing: Map these required fields to continue: {fields}

options.title: Import options
options.existingHint: Matched by employee number or Iqama (employees), code or name (master data).
options.createMissing: Create missing departments, job titles and locations
options.createMissingHint: Names in the file that don't exist yet are added to master data.
options.professionAsJobTitle: Use the Iqama profession as job title
options.professionAsJobTitleHint: When the job title is empty, the profession is matched to (or added as) a job title.
options.defaultStatusHint: Used when the file has no status column.
options.leaveModeAvailableHint: Opening balance = the value, this year's entitlement = 0.
options.leaveModeCarryoverHint: Opening balance = the value, plus the leave type's yearly entitlement.
options.existingUpdateDenied: You don't have permission to update existing records.

review.title: Review the rows
review.description: Every row was checked against the rules and the existing data. Rows with errors are not imported.
review.nothingToImport: No rows can be imported — fix the errors in the file and upload it again.
review.confirmDescription: {create} new and {update} updated records will be saved. {errors} rows with errors and {skip} skipped rows are not imported.
review.confirmNoLogins: No login accounts are created for imported employees.

run.title: Importing
run.description: Keep this page open until the import finishes.
run.batchFailed: The import stopped because of a connection problem. Nothing was lost — continue from where it stopped.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Imports from the app and the command line, newest first.

empty.title: No imports yet
empty.description: Imported files and their results appear here.

errorsEmpty.title: No error reports
errorsEmpty.description: Imports with rejected rows appear here with a downloadable report.

export.title: Export data
export.description: Datasets you are allowed to export. Files include every row you can access; open a list page to export with filters.

empty.title: Nothing to export yet
empty.description: Export datasets appear here when you have export permission for them.

templates.title: Import templates
templates.description: XLSX templates with the recognized columns, an example row, drop-down lists and bilingual instructions.
templates.noPermission: You don't have permission to import this data.
templates.exampleNote: Example row — replace or delete it. It is skipped automatically when importing.

rules.rule1: Keep the header row. Columns can be in any order; Arabic or English headers are accepted.
rules.rule2: The grey row is an example — it is skipped automatically.
rules.rule3: Dates: yyyy-mm-dd, dd/mm/yyyy or Excel dates. Hijri dates (e.g. 1447/05/12) are converted.
rules.rule4: Refer to employees by employee number or Iqama / ID number, and to departments by code or name — never by internal IDs.
rules.rule5: Nothing is imported until you review the validation results and confirm.
rules.ruleEmployees1: Arabic names are imported exactly as written. Blank emails stay empty.
rules.ruleEmployees2: Columns that don't match a field are kept unchanged in the employee's additional data.
rules.ruleEmployees3: Importing employees does not create login accounts.

formats.identifier: Text (kept exactly, format the column as text)
formats.outsideKingdom: Yes / No (or Inside / Outside the Kingdom)

report.title: Import error report
report.howToFix: Fix the rows in the original file (row numbers match the spreadsheet) and import it again with “Update existing records”.

errors.unsupportedFormat: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file.
errors.legacyXls: Old Excel files (.xls) are not supported. Save the file as .xlsx and upload it again.
errors.corruptFile: The file could not be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has more than 20,000 rows. Split it into smaller files.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.importBusy: This import is already running in another window.
errors.importNotEditable: This import has already been completed or cancelled.
errors.missingRequired: Map the required fields before continuing.
errors.sourceExpired: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload it again.
errors.nothingToImport: There are no valid rows to import.

toast.importedWithErrors: Import complete with {count} rows not saved.
